author: Davidgo5867

english.text: The Web gives people now enormous wealth. Imagine that in the 1970s, if you wanted to know about yellow-fleshed watermelons, going to the public library wouldn't give you any information. Now, you just instantly search the Web for lots of information. There is a graphic boom. There is an audio boom. All of it is because of the Web. Don't be blind. In the 1970s, you were satisfied with blurry photographs, but not now.

jyutping: mong5 lok6 ji4 gaa1 bei2 dou3 jan4 dei6 geoi6 daai6 ge3 coi4 fu3。soeng2 zoeng6 jat1 haa5，hai2 1970 nin4 doi6，jyu4 gwo2 nei5 soeng2 zi1 dou3 wong4 juk6 sai1 gwaa1，heoi3 gung1 gung6 tou4 syu1 gun2 dou1 m4 wui5 bei2 dou3 jam6 ho4 zi1 liu2 nei5。ji4 gaa1，nei5 zi2 seoi1 jiu3 zik1 hak1 hai2 mong5 lok6 soeng6 min6 sau2 cam4 hou2 do1 zi1 seon3。jau5 jat1 go3 jam1 pan4 jit6 ciu4。so2 jau5 ni1 di1 dou1 hai6 jan1 wai6 mong5 lok6。m4 hou2 maang4 muk6。hai2 1970 nin4 doi6，nei5 deoi3 mou4 wu4 ge3 soeng3 pin2 gam2 dou3 mun5 ji3，daan6 hai6 ji4 gaa1 m4 hai6。
text: 網絡而家畀到人哋巨大嘅財富。想像一下，喺1970年代，如果你想知道黃肉西瓜，去公共圖書館都唔會畀到任何資料你。而家，你只需要即刻喺網絡上面搜尋好多資訊。有一個音頻熱潮。所有呢啲都係因為網絡。唔好盲目。喺1970年代，你對模糊嘅相片感到滿意，但係而家唔係。
